goal: Validate whether anonymous Prometheus push requests in a default HertzBeat deployment can grow process-lifetime push monitor state until a dynamic DoS signal appears.

default_deployment_plan.reason: The local official compose files pin apache/hertzbeat:1.8.0. Docker Hub direct pull returned EOF, so the same upstream image/tag was pulled through docker.m.daocloud.io.
harness_changes: Map host ports to 2157/2158 to avoid collisions.
Set Docker memory and memory-swap limit to 768m for an isolated safety cap.

probe_plan.loop_variable: unique job and instance path segments

evidence_to_collect: post-probe logs containing auto-create monitor events

static_candidate.driver: attacker-controlled unique job and instance path segments
